title: Sexism Identification in Tweets and Gabs using Deep Neural Networks

bias_targets.methodology: Training deep neural networks to classify texts as sexist or non-sexist using the EXIST 2021 dataset, and conducting an error analysis to check for model over-sensitivity (bias) towards texts containing feminine terms (e.g., 'woman', 'girl') or terms related to feminism.
Analyzing confusion matrices for texts containing profanities to determine if the model incorrectly correlates the presence of vulgar language with sexism (false positives).
